claims.summary: Observed: astrid:llm implements a non-destructive scanner for known model control markers; scan_known_model_control_markers (L114-143) keeps a marker in `remainder` only if it has a valid reference_syntax (L129-131), filtering bare markers while preserving referenced ones.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Source at SHA 902a0358 L114-143: for each occurrence, L124 computes reference_syntax; L129-131 pushes occurrence.token to remainder iff reference_syntax.is_some(); otherwise the marker bytes are omitted from remainder (still recorded in `matches`). Exactly her mechanism. Same finding as prior packet introspection_astrid_llm_1787699463 c001.

L64-86 list contains 'functions' (L74) and NOT 'operates'; L89-96 lowercases the first alnum word after the marker; unmatched + no delimiter => reference_syntax()=None (L59) => L129 skips the push => marker omitted. Widening the allowlist is a Tier-5 production marker-grammar change, not authorized and not done. Same as prior packet c002.
